name: Pembrolizumab (single-agent checkpoint inhibitor)
cyclesNote: continue every 3 weeks until progression or unacceptable toxicity (up to about 2 years); a 400 mg every-6-week schedule is an accepted alternative. Physician determined.

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Baseline and periodic assessment for immune-related adverse events (skin, gut, liver, endocrine, lung).
Have a corticosteroid and immune-toxicity management pathway available.
monitoring: Thyroid, adrenal/pituitary, glucose at baseline and periodically.
Liver and renal function each cycle; symptom-driven assessment for colitis and pneumonitis.
Response assessment by imaging every 2 to 3 cycles.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV over about 30 minutes on day 1 every 3 weeks (an alternative flat schedule is 400 mg every 6 weeks). Single-agent anti-PD-1 therapy for mismatch-repair-deficient / MSI-high advanced endometrial carcinoma progressing after chemo-immunotherapy, or where a chemo backbone is not appropriate. Flat fixed dose; not weight- or BSA-scaled. Author's own wording; general reference NCCN / DeVita.
